paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: dsh-web-search-exa
# dsh-web-search-exa

An Exa search provider for DeepSeek Harness. It registers the provider `exa`
on the `@deepseek-ai/ds

h-web` seam, so the `web_search` tool sends its queries to Exa's
`/search` API and returns the resul

ts as sources. It works the same from dsh web, dsh-TUI and
headless runs. `web_fetch` is unchanged.
The plugin has no UI of its own.

The bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` pins the web seam's `searchProvider` to
`exa` and adds the `web-sear
ch-exa` row. Restart dsh web after installing.

This release is qualified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; its peer pin is exact, so other DSH
versions nee
d `dsh plugin allow-version` or a newer release.
## Configuration

Override the row in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the whole row
config, so
restate any field you keep.
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `EXA_API_KEY` | Key name: looked up in dsh's credential store, then (after `apiKeyFi

le`) in the environment |
| `apiKeyFile` | (unset) | File holding the key (raw or dotenv), read on e

very search, so a rotated key needs no restart; it wins over the environment |
| `apiKey` | (unset)

| Literal key, used before any other source (avoid) |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.exa.ai` | Exa API o

rigin |
| `type` | `auto` | Exa search type |
| `highlightChars` | `600` | Highlight length per resu

lt |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Request timeout |

## Development

`nix flake check` runs the fast suites against the pinned dsh; `nix run .#e2e` runs the real
dsh web

(Playwright), dsh-TUI (private tmux) and headless suites against a local mock Exa.

TING.md and RELEASING.md.
